title: The radial lift of a K-Lipschitz profile has ‖Dζ(x)‖ ≤ K/ρ everywhere
statement: Let m ∈ N, ξ ∈ R^m (Euclidean space EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin m)), ρ > 0, K ∈ ℝ≥0, and let φ : R → R be K-Lipschitz, i.e. |φ(s) − φ(t)| <= K|s − t| for all s, t. Put ζ(y) := φ(‖y − ξ‖/ρ). Then for every x ∈ R^m the Fréchet derivative of ζ at x satisfies ‖Dζ(x)‖ <= K/ρ (operator norm). In Lean this is fderiv ℝ ζ x, which is 0 wherever ζ is not differentiable.
lean_statement: ∀ (m : ℕ) (ξ : Rn m) (ρ : ℝ) (K : ℝ≥0) (φ : ℝ → ℝ), 0 < ρ → LipschitzWith K φ → ∀ x : Rn m, ‖fderiv ℝ (fun y : Rn m => φ (‖y - ξ‖ / ρ)) x‖ ≤ (K : ℝ) / ρ
